model.channel_coordinates: h=(r,0); covariance is expressed in the channel-parallel / complex-orthogonal basis.
model.physical_equal_summary_family: In balanced physical basis u=(1,i)/sqrt(2),v=(i,1)/sqrt(2), every C_a has diagonal T/2 and |offdiag|=(kappa1-kappa2)/2; hence identical branch marginals/norm law/spectrum/entropy/isotropic-reference KL.
model.interpretation: Full covariance changes. All-positive-epsilon and practical-estimator optimality are not hypotheses.

integration.method: Independent scrambled Sobol RQMC in10 dimensions, exact NR64QAM bit-logMAP, teacher posterior KL, antithetic errors.
integration.error_factor: nu0=sqrt(kappa1*x)*z0-sqrt(kappa2*(1-x))*z1; nu1=sqrt(kappa1*(1-x))*z0+sqrt(kappa2*x)*z1; z0,z1 iid CN(0,1). Same Gaussian inputs for every x; samplewise norm constant across x.
integration.common_scale: One s>=0 per law/grid/integration replicate outside all error/observation/bit averages; optimize the full population approximation, never per realization.
integration.derivative: Envelope E[KL_sample*S_a] with the orthogonal-phase-averaged density score, evaluated at the optimized single scale. Original CN(C_a) samples give the same expectation after independent true-observation averaging.
integration.score: A=|nu0|^2,B=|nu1|^2,D=kappa1*kappa2,T=kappa1+kappa2,p=(a-kappa2)*(kappa1-a),z=p*A*B/D^2; S=(A-B)/D+(T-2*a)*A*B/D^2*I1(2sqrt(z))/(sqrt(z)*I0(2sqrt(z))); the ratio continues as1 at z=0.
integration.symbol_balance: Every64QAM symbol appears equally in each Sobol prefix; signs are dependent integration pairs, not independent experimental samples.

numerical_precision_rule.policy: If any precision diagnostic at any fixed grid point or adjacent contrast exceeds its target, add the next power for the entire grid/all four scrambles. Preserve every level, every derivative sign and every risk; do not stop or select a range based on a positive sign. At power18, report nonconvergence if targets are unmet.
numerical_precision_rule.interpretation: Scramble SE and nested drift are numerical convergence diagnostics, not confidence guarantees or certification of the complete continuous orbit. Actual derivative/gain signs are reported independently of precision status.
